name: landflow
description: Landflow — a low-code workflow platform with autodiscovered, polyglot node plugins.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:deps && pnpm check:claude-plugin && pnpm check:history && pnpm check:docs && pnpm test:scripts
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n web,ts,py,go,msg,prod,google,db,linear,attio,fathom -c magenta,blue,yellow,cyan,green,red,white,gray,blue,green,yellow "pnpm dev" "pnpm plugin:ts" "pnpm plugin:py" "pnpm plugin:go" "pnpm plugin:messaging" "pnpm plugin:productivity" "pnpm plugin:google" "pnpm plugin:databases" "pnpm plugin:linear" "pnpm plugin:attio" "pnpm plugin:fathom"
scripts.dev:all:browser: concurrently -k -n web,ts,py,go,msg,prod,google,db,browser -c magenta,blue,yellow,cyan,green,red,white,gray,black "pnpm dev" "pnpm plugin:ts" "pnpm plugin:py" "pnpm plugin:go" "pnpm plugin:messaging" "pnpm plugin:productivity" "pnpm plugin:google" "pnpm plugin:databases" "pnpm plugin:browser"
scripts.dev:all:agent-shell: concurrently -k -n web,ts,py,go,msg,prod,google,db,shell -c magenta,blue,yellow,cyan,green,red,white,gray,black "pnpm dev" "pnpm plugin:ts" "pnpm plugin:py" "pnpm plugin:go" "pnpm plugin:messaging" "pnpm plugin:productivity" "pnpm plugin:google" "pnpm plugin:databases" "pnpm plugin:agent-shell"
scripts.dev:all:web-search: concurrently -k -n web,ts,py,go,msg,prod,google,db,search -c magenta,blue,yellow,cyan,green,red,white,gray,black "pnpm dev" "pnpm plugin:ts" "pnpm plugin:py" "pnpm plugin:go" "pnpm plugin:messaging" "pnpm plugin:productivity" "pnpm plugin:google" "pnpm plugin:databases" "pnpm plugin:web-search"
